# Pass 7 blocking at real density (generated by `python -m src.pass7`)

Val queries against the full 2.2M train S1 index, 1,527,889 true val pairs. Pass 3/5 reference (same queries): pair recall 0.9019 unpruned, **0.8975 pruned (n=3)**, F0.5 ceiling 0.9476, 4.8 pairs per query record. Pruning keeps every hit of the Pass 3 keys plus the top n by prune_score; the Pass 7 channels (address anchors, skip-bigrams, 8-character prefix) compete for those n slots, with true TF-IDF cosines recomputed for every pair. PRUNE n = 3 is used downstream.
